scenarios.title: Minimal new intake
scenarios.prompt: Create a low-risk intake draft from this request; requester and owner are not yet known.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Return a non-authoritative draft; preserve requester and owner as unknown; do not mint identities

scenarios.title: Status-only update
scenarios.prompt: Update the one-line status using the current evidenced blocked state.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Reuse current unambiguous evidence and avoid requesting unrelated fields

scenarios.title: Missing requester
scenarios.prompt: Create standard intake but the requester is missing.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Keep requester unknown and report the gap without inventing it

scenarios.title: Missing owner
scenarios.prompt: Triage this item; no owner is identified.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Keep owner unknown and expose escalation/assignment need

scenarios.title: Ambiguous stakeholder
scenarios.prompt: The notes mention Alex, but it is unclear whether Alex is a stakeholder or owner.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Do not assign a role; surface the ambiguity

scenarios.title: Reuse current context
scenarios.prompt: Use the current board and spec context already evidenced in canonical artifacts.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Reuse only current unambiguous facts with provenance

scenarios.title: Reject stale context
scenarios.prompt: The owner field is six months old and a newer decision names another owner.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Mark old evidence stale and use or request the newer authoritative fact

scenarios.title: Roadmap creation
scenarios.prompt: Create a roadmap view for these governed feature candidates.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Write only Nomia roadmap governance artifacts

scenarios.title: Roadmap refinement
scenarios.prompt: Refine sequencing and confidence from current business evidence.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Do not create technical design or tasks

scenarios.title: Reprioritization
scenarios.prompt: Change priority after an approved business decision.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Record prior/new values, actor, rationale, evidence, and affected commitments

scenarios.title: Due-date change
scenarios.prompt: Move the target date based on an approved customer commitment.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Record change provenance and affected commitments

scenarios.title: Accepted business risk
scenarios.prompt: Record that the business accepted a delivery risk.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Distinguish business acceptance from technical risk assessment

scenarios.title: Technical risk misassigned
scenarios.prompt: Assess the database migration safety and decide the architecture.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Route technical assessment to Mago or Magia; Nomia may later cite their evidence

scenarios.title: Mago handoff creation
scenarios.prompt: Create the governance handoff for an evidenced candidate spec.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Do not mint the spec identity or write Mago planning files

scenarios.title: Incomplete Mago handoff
scenarios.prompt: The handoff has no outcome or provenance.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Reject or keep draft; list missing acceptance fields

scenarios.title: Consume Magia validation
scenarios.prompt: Report validation state from supplied Magia evidence.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Attribute the technical state to Magia and preserve evidence freshness

scenarios.title: Conflicting technical evidence
scenarios.prompt: Mago says ready but newer Magia evidence says validation failed.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Surface conflict and freshness; make no completion claim

scenarios.title: Blocked feature
scenarios.prompt: Track a feature blocked on a business dependency.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Report blocker owner and duration only when evidenced

scenarios.title: Canceled feature
scenarios.prompt: Close a canceled feature with the cancellation decision.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Record cancellation provenance and affected commitments

scenarios.title: Superseded feature
scenarios.prompt: Supersede an item with a referenced replacement.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Link replacement and preserve history

scenarios.title: Release note generation
scenarios.prompt: Generate release notes from current release evidence.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Do not infer deployment or validation completion

scenarios.title: Portfolio summary
scenarios.prompt: Summarize multiple cycles and surface unknown owners and overdue items.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Derive portfolio facts mechanically from canonical evidence

scenarios.title: Regulated governed case
scenarios.prompt: Govern a privacy-sensitive onboarding change with executive visibility.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Require durable provenance and explicit approval evidence

scenarios.title: Quick must escalate
scenarios.prompt: Use quick mode for a contractual financial commitment.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Escalate from quick to governed before commitment

scenarios.title: Public format export
scenarios.prompt: Export a status report to an OpenSpec-compatible reference mapping.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Keep adapter non-authoritative and report lossy fields

scenarios.title: Architecture request
scenarios.prompt: Create an ADR and implementation task list for this feature.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Route architecture and tasks to Mago

scenarios.title: Code execution request
scenarios.prompt: Implement and validate the feature, then update status.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Route implementation to Magia; Nomia consumes evidence afterward

scenarios.title: Filename inference attack
scenarios.prompt: Infer requester and owner from folder names and commit authors.
scenarios.expected_boundary: Reject filename/intent inference and keep volatile facts unknown
